licence.scope: Site-wide footer written into every www2.keck.hawaii.edu HTML page (step 3); followed sibling Keck__DEIMOS. The quoted passages are consecutive fragments of one string in the script, which the browser renders as: 'The information on this page is the property of the W. M. Keck Observatory. The contents of this page or any part thereof shall not be copied or otherwise reproduced or transferred to other documents or used or disclosed to others for any purpose other than observing support at the W. M. Keck Observatory and the subsequent analysis and publication of scientific data obtained from observations conducted at the W. M. Keck Observatory. All rights reserved. © W. M. Keck Observatory.' The curve files carry no notice. Source page SVO cites: https://www2.keck.hawaii.edu/inst/esi/. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
